title: Impact of Diet on Functional Gastrointestinal Symptoms
brief_summary: This cross-sectional survey study is to determine the prevalence of functional gastrointestinal (GI) disorders in the general population and to describe common triggers for food-related GI symptoms.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\-

Exclusion Criteria:

* Visual impairment
* Inability to read
* Inability to understand English
* Inability to use a computer to respond to questions.
study_population: General popultion in the United States
